cut_rhythm: 2-8 seconds per beat; preserve the hook and final payoff
narration: one continuous measured narration or approved excerpt

safe_area.vertical: TikTok/Shorts controls excluded from 12% lower and side zones

voice: provider-selected; simulated provider permitted for generic smoke tests
music: optional; ducking and limiter required when present
effects: Canvas particles, fog and light accents from the shared renderer
medallion: not required for generic profile; explicit in project if used
transitions: soft deterministic dissolve; no black frames
